Of the
malignant conditions, children younger than 2 are more likely to suffer from neuroblastoma and hepatoblastoma,
where as older children are more susceptible to Wilms tumour, hepatocellular carcinoma, genitourinary tract
tumours, and germline tumour
Ataxia telangiectasia and aniridia (Wilms tumour) also do, so the question has several defensible options.
